Issues certified invoices for paid orders.

The Moloni company in whose name invoices are issued. A Moloni user can have access to several companies, so choose the store's.

The list shows the companies the user entered in step 1 can access. If the store's company is missing, give that user access to it in Moloni and reopen this window.

Choosing another company clears the series, payment methods, category and unit below, because they belong to one company.

In Moloni this value is called Developer ID. It identifies the application that accesses the Moloni API on behalf of the store (in the API it is the client_id parameter).

To get it, open the Moloni developer area (moloni.pt/dev), sign in with the store's Moloni account and register an application, for example "Online store". Moloni then shows the Developer ID and the Client Secret.

Copy the Developer ID into this field and the Client Secret into the next one.

The secret key of the application registered in the Moloni developer area (moloni.pt/dev), shown next to the Developer ID (in the API it is the client_secret parameter).

It is stored encrypted and only a masked version is shown afterwards. Leave the field empty to keep the saved value.

If you think the secret was exposed, generate a new one in the Moloni developer area and paste it here.

The e-mail of the Moloni user the plugin signs in with to issue invoices. Moloni's API requires a user's credentials together with the Developer ID and Client Secret.

We recommend creating a Moloni user just for the online store, with only the permissions needed to issue documents, instead of the owner's personal account. That way, changing the personal password does not break invoicing, and the store's access can be revoked without affecting anything else.

The user must have access to the company whose ID you enter in Company ID.

The password of the Moloni user entered in Username.

It is stored encrypted and only a masked version is shown afterwards. Leave the field empty to keep the saved value.

If the password of that user changes in Moloni, enter the new one here, otherwise invoices stop being issued.
Step 1 of 2: enter the {name} API credentials. After they are checked, the other settings are loaded from your {name} account.

The document series in which the store's invoices are issued (for example a series called "Online store").

The list shows the document series of the company chosen above, read from your Moloni account. To use a new series, create it in Moloni (Document series, in the settings area) and reopen this window.

Left empty, the first series in Moloni is used.

If the list cannot be loaded, the field accepts the ID typed by hand.

Only needed if some product variant is sold with 0% VAT. By law, every invoice line without VAT must state the exemption reason.

The list shows the reasons Moloni accepts, by Tax Authority (AT) code, for example M07 (exempt under article 9 of the VAT Code) or M99 (not subject or not taxed). Confirm the right one with your accountant.

If every variant has VAT above 0%, leave it empty. If a variant has 0% VAT and this field is empty, the invoice is not issued and an error asks for the reason.

The payment method recorded on invoice-receipts for payments made on the store (for example "Card" or "Stripe").

The list shows the payment methods of the company chosen above, read from your Moloni account. To use a new one, create it in Moloni (Payment methods, in the settings area) and reopen this window.

Left empty, the first payment method in Moloni is used.

If the list cannot be loaded, the field accepts the ID typed by hand.

The payment method used for the part of an order paid with a voucher or store credit, so that it does not appear as a card payment.

The list shows the payment methods of the company chosen above, read from your Moloni account. You can create one in Moloni, for example "Store credit", and reopen this window.

Left empty, the payment method above is used.

If the list cannot be loaded, the field accepts the ID typed by hand.

Moloni can only invoice articles that exist in its catalogue. When a product SKU does not exist there yet, the plugin creates the article automatically, and Moloni requires a category for it.

The list shows the product categories of the company chosen above, read from your Moloni account. Subcategories show as "Parent › Child".

Left empty, the first category in Moloni is used.

If the list cannot be loaded, the field accepts the ID typed by hand.

Like the category, every article the plugin creates in Moloni needs a measurement unit (for example "Unit").

The list shows the measurement units of the company chosen above, read from your Moloni account.

Left empty, the first unit in Moloni is used.

If the list cannot be loaded, the field accepts the ID typed by hand.

The reference of the Moloni article that represents shipping costs on invoices.

If you already have a shipping article in Moloni, open Articles, find it and copy its Reference field exactly as it appears.

If you leave this field empty, the reference PORTES is used. If no article with that reference exists, the plugin creates it in Moloni as a service.
